text: The text references the Paris Agreement and international discussions on climate change involving pledges to reduce carbon emissions. The Paris Agreement was adopted in 2015 and entered into force in 2016, marking a significant milestone in global climate policy. The language used, such as "globally recognized standards" and the context of a "recent environmental summit," suggests the text originates from the late 2010s or the 2020s, a period characterized by heightened global focus on implementing the goals set forth in the Paris Agreement. Therefore, the time period is contemporary, specifically post-2015.
